category_title: Pupils with high SNA dependence and learned helplessness
scenario_title: Older pupil rejecting constant SNA proximity
minimal_context: The student is preparing to start a classroom assignment while the SNA pulls up a chair to sit directly beside his desk.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am going to pull my chair up right beside your desk so we can do this assignment together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't need you right here. I want to do it like the boys do.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I'm just going to stay right here next to you to make sure you stay on task.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want to be like everyone else in the class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to get this finished, so I will sit here and help you.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want anyone sitting next to me! I need to have my own space now!
